validated_results.title: Decomposing difference in the kidney cancer burden measures between 1990 and 2019 based on the global burden of disease study.
validated_results.reason: This ecological Global Burden of Disease decomposition reports only aggregate contributions of risk factors, including alcohol, to changes in combined kidney cancer burden measures, so no separable alcohol-specific incidence estimate is available.
